blocks.en: While exploring in EVE Online,
blocks.zh: 在 EVE Online 中探索时，

blocks.en: you will sooner or later happen across a wormhole.
blocks.zh: 你迟早会碰到虫洞。

blocks.en: These mysterious holes in space can lead almost anywhere,
blocks.zh: 这些神秘的空间裂隙几乎可以通往任何地方，

blocks.en: including distant, mysterious systems far removed from normal space.
blocks.zh: 包括远离常规空间的遥远神秘星系。

blocks.en: While wormhole space can be dangerous, it can also be extremely lucrative
blocks.zh: 虫洞空间虽然危险，但对于敢于闯入黑暗的

blocks.en: for those Capsuleers willing to brave the darkness.
blocks.zh: 克隆飞行员来说，也可能利润极其丰厚。

blocks.en: Wormholes are hidden Cosmic Signatures and can only be located through scanning,
blocks.zh: 虫洞是隐藏的宇宙信号，只能通过扫描找到，

blocks.en: much like relic and data sites.
blocks.zh: 和遗迹站点、数据站点很像。

blocks.en: If you need a refresher on scanning, check out the Scanning Basics video.
blocks.zh: 如果需要复习扫描知识，请观看《扫描基础》视频。

blocks.en: Once you have a wormhole fully scanned
blocks.zh: 完全扫出虫洞后，

blocks.en: you can warp to it to find anominous spherical portal in space.
blocks.zh: 你就可以跃迁过去，看到太空中一个不祥的球形传送门。

blocks.en: Before diving in, you should assess the hole to gather information
blocks.zh: 跳进去之前，你应该先评估一下这个虫洞，收集信息：

blocks.en: right click and Show Info on the wormhole to bring up more details.
blocks.zh: 右键点击虫洞，选择「显示信息」查看详情。

blocks.en: This will bring up a panel which displays useful information about the hole
blocks.zh: 这会打开一个面板，显示该虫洞的有用信息，

blocks.en: including where the wormhole leads to,
blocks.zh: 包括虫洞通往哪里，

blocks.en: such as a high, low, or null security system.
blocks.zh: 比如高安、低安还是 00 区星系。

blocks.en: If this text mentions 'unknown' parts of space,
blocks.zh: 如果文字中提到「未知（unknown）」空间，

blocks.en: then it leads to a wormhole system outside of normal space.
blocks.zh: 说明它通往常规空间之外的虫洞星系。

blocks.en: Wormhole systems are divided into 6 different classes
blocks.zh: 虫洞星系分为 6 个等级，

blocks.en: commonly known as C1 through C6.
blocks.zh: 通常称为 C1 到 C6。

blocks.en: These represent the danger of the NPC sites and relative hostility
blocks.zh: 等级代表 NPC 站点的危险程度，

blocks.en: of any environmental effects that you might encounter.
blocks.zh: 以及你可能遇到的环境效应的恶劣程度。

blocks.en: When this text reads simply as 'unknown' space,
blocks.zh: 如果文字只写着「未知」空间，

blocks.en: you know that this is a C1, C2, or C3 system.
blocks.zh: 那就是 C1、C2 或 C3 星系。

blocks.en: If you see 'dangerous unknown' parts of space instead,
blocks.zh: 如果写的是「危险的未知（dangerous unknown）」空间，

blocks.en: then it's a C4 or C5,
blocks.zh: 那就是 C4 或 C5，

blocks.en: and 'deadly' space refers to a class 6 system.
blocks.zh: 而「致命（deadly）」空间指的是 C6 星系。

blocks.en: Determining the exact class of a wormhole is a bit more difficult,
blocks.zh: 要确定虫洞的确切等级就难一些了，

blocks.en: as this involves relying on visual clues from the wormhole itself,
blocks.zh: 这需要依靠虫洞本身的视觉线索，

blocks.en: or looking up the wormhole type out of game.
blocks.zh: 或者在游戏外查询虫洞类型。

blocks.en: In the center of a wormhole
blocks.zh: 在虫洞中心，

blocks.en: you can see the background nebulae of the system on the other side.
blocks.zh: 你能看到另一侧星系的背景星云。

blocks.en: Higher class wormholes appear darker and more red
blocks.zh: 一般来说，等级越高的虫洞看起来

blocks.en: than lower class ones as a general rule, but more on that later.
blocks.zh: 越暗、越红，稍后会详细介绍。

blocks.en: On the next line, you can get a rough idea of how long is left
blocks.zh: 下一行能让你大致了解

blocks.en: before this wormhole collapses, disappearing forever.
blocks.zh: 这个虫洞还有多久会坍塌、永远消失。

blocks.en: If it reads 'end of life' then take care,
blocks.zh: 如果显示「寿命将尽（end of life）」，就要小心了，

blocks.en: as the wormhole will collapse sometime within the next four hours.
blocks.zh: 虫洞会在接下来 4 小时内的某个时刻坍塌。

blocks.en: The last two sections refer to the maximum size of ship
blocks.zh: 最后两部分是指能跳跃通过该虫洞的

blocks.en: which can jump through that wormhole, and the total remaining mass.
blocks.zh: 最大舰船尺寸，以及剩余的总质量。

blocks.en: If enough large ships pass through the wormhole
blocks.zh: 如果足够多的大型舰船通过虫洞，

blocks.en: then it will eventually collapse and sever the connection.
blocks.zh: 它最终会坍塌，连接就此断开。

blocks.en: Collapsing a wormhole by passing ships through it
blocks.zh: 通过让舰船穿越来使虫洞坍塌，

blocks.en: is commonly referred to as 'rolling'.
blocks.zh: 通常被称为「滚洞（rolling）」。

blocks.en: The visual appearance of the wormhole
blocks.zh: 虫洞的外观

blocks.en: can give you additional clues as to its nature.
blocks.zh: 也能为你提供有关其性质的更多线索。

blocks.en: In the center of a wormhole you can glimpse the sky on the other side,
blocks.zh: 在虫洞中心可以瞥见另一侧的天空，

blocks.en: this can allow you to identify the specific class of wormhole system
blocks.zh: 借此可以判断你眼前的

blocks.en: that you are looking at.
blocks.zh: 虫洞星系的具体等级。

blocks.en: Wormholes leading to class 1 systems have gray clouds and black features.
blocks.zh: 通往 C1 星系的虫洞有灰色云雾和黑色纹理，

blocks.en: They are overall very muted in color.
blocks.zh: 整体色调非常暗淡。

blocks.en: Class 2 wormholes have a more brown hue and are most easily identified
blocks.zh: C2 虫洞更偏棕色调，最容易辨认的特征是

blocks.en: by black cloud visible within a brighter grey cloud.
blocks.zh: 较亮的灰云中可见黑色云团。

blocks.en: Class 3 wormholes will again have a background of grey clouds,
blocks.zh: C3 虫洞同样以灰色云雾为背景，

blocks.en: but you will notice bright red clouds visible among them.
blocks.zh: 但你会注意到其中有鲜红色的云。

blocks.en: Class 4 wormholes have a distinct dark red color
blocks.zh: C4 虫洞呈现明显的暗红色，

blocks.en: with contrasting bright white and dark black clouds.
blocks.zh: 还有对比强烈的亮白色和深黑色云团。

blocks.en: Class 5 holes are dark reddish brown
blocks.zh: C5 虫洞呈暗红棕色，

blocks.en: and appear somewhat more muted than their class 4 counterparts.
blocks.zh: 看起来比 C4 虫洞稍微暗淡一些。

blocks.en: And lastly,
blocks.zh: 最后，

blocks.en: class 6 holes are a vibrant and violent mix of orange and reds.
blocks.zh: C6 虫洞是橙色和红色交织的鲜艳狂暴景象。

blocks.en: If the wormhole leads to known space,
blocks.zh: 如果虫洞通往已知空间，

blocks.en: you can even identify the region it leads to
blocks.zh: 你甚至可以通过背景中的星云

blocks.en: by looking at the nebulas visible in the background.
blocks.zh: 认出它通往哪个星域。

blocks.en: The wispy rings dancing at the edges of a wormhole
blocks.zh: 虫洞边缘舞动的缕缕光环

blocks.en: also give you information at a glance about what ships can pass through it.
blocks.zh: 也能让你一眼看出哪些舰船可以通过。

blocks.en: A pure blue color indicates it is a small wormhole
blocks.zh: 纯蓝色表示这是小型虫洞，

blocks.en: through which only frigate sized ships may pass.
blocks.zh: 只允许护卫舰尺寸的舰船通过。

blocks.en: Teal indicates the wormhole is medium in size,
blocks.zh: 青绿色表示中型虫洞，

blocks.en: allowing ships up to battlecruisers to pass through.
blocks.zh: 战列巡洋舰及以下的舰船都可通过。

blocks.en: Gray indicates a wormhole through which any subcapital ship can pass.
blocks.zh: 灰色表示所有非旗舰级舰船都能通过的虫洞。

blocks.en: And lastly a yellow gold color indicates a massive wormhole
blocks.zh: 最后，金黄色表示巨型虫洞，

blocks.en: through which even some capital ships and freighters may be able to travel.
blocks.zh: 甚至部分旗舰和货舰也可能通过。

blocks.en: Now that we know almost everything there is to learn about this wormhole,
blocks.zh: 现在我们几乎了解了这个虫洞的一切，

blocks.en: it's time to venture inside.
blocks.zh: 是时候进去冒险了。

blocks.en: If you're feeling confident,
blocks.zh: 如果你有信心，

blocks.en: right-click the wormhole and choose Enter Wormhole to pass through it.
blocks.zh: 右键点击虫洞，选择「进入虫洞（Enter Wormhole）」穿过去。

blocks.en: When you jump into a wormhole system you will find yourself far from home
blocks.zh: 跳进虫洞星系后，你会发现自己已远离家园，

blocks.en: in a system represented by a J followed by a six digit number,
blocks.zh: 身处一个以 J 加六位数字命名的星系，

blocks.en: commonly referred to as a "J-Code".
blocks.zh: 通常称为「J 代码（J-Code）」。

blocks.en: Notice that these systems have a negative 1.0 security value,
blocks.zh: 注意这些星系的安全等级为 -1.0，

blocks.en: meaning that you need to watch out
blocks.zh: 这意味着你必须提防

blocks.en: for or other Capsuleers hidden in the darkness.
blocks.zh: 潜伏在黑暗中的其他克隆飞行员。

blocks.en: Cloaking devices in wormholes are both common place and highly recommended.
blocks.zh: 在虫洞中，隐身设备既普遍又强烈推荐使用。

blocks.en: You may also notice an environmental effect in the wormhole
blocks.zh: 你可能还会注意到虫洞中的环境效应，

blocks.en: which can be seen above your capacitor.
blocks.zh: 它显示在电容上方。

blocks.en: If you need more information about the wormhole itself,
blocks.zh: 如果你需要更多关于虫洞本身的信息，

blocks.en: including the exact class of the wormhole,
blocks.zh: 包括虫洞的确切等级，

blocks.en: you can find out by checking Capsuleer-created intel tools online.
blocks.zh: 可以查询克隆飞行员制作的在线情报工具。

blocks.en: There are no stargates or NPC stations in wormhole space.
blocks.zh: 虫洞空间里没有星门，也没有 NPC 空间站。

blocks.en: Navigating between systems is only possible by using a scanner
blocks.zh: 只能借助扫描在星系之间穿行，

blocks.en: so be sure to right click and bookmark your way home
blocks.zh: 所以在继续深入之前，

blocks.en: before venturing further in.
blocks.zh: 一定要右键保存好回家路线的书签。

blocks.en: Local chat in wormholes operates in delayed mode,
blocks.zh: 虫洞中的本地频道采用延迟模式，

blocks.en: meaning that you won't appear in the list of pilots unless you type in Local.
blocks.zh: 也就是说，除非你在本地频道发言，否则不会出现在飞行员列表中。

blocks.en: While you cannot directly see if other players are in system with you,
blocks.zh: 虽然你无法直接看到星系里是否有其他玩家，

blocks.en: you can, however, use the directional scanner to search for ships within range
blocks.zh: 但可以使用定向扫描（D-Scan）搜索范围内

blocks.en: that you should be aware of.
blocks.zh: 需要留意的舰船。

blocks.en: The d-scan menu can be opened by clicking the scanners button next to the capacitor
blocks.zh: 点击电容旁的扫描器按钮，

blocks.en: and clicking on the directional scanner.
blocks.zh: 再点击定向扫描器，即可打开定向扫描菜单。

blocks.en: This will open the directional scan window and the system map.
blocks.zh: 这会打开定向扫描窗口和星系地图。

blocks.en: Because we will be using d-scan often,
blocks.zh: 由于我们会经常使用定向扫描，

blocks.en: we can undock the directional scan window from the system map
blocks.zh: 可以点击分离按钮，

blocks.en: by clicking the undock button.
blocks.zh: 把定向扫描窗口从星系地图中分离出来。

blocks.en: There's plenty to do in wormhole space,
blocks.zh: 虫洞空间里有很多事可做，

blocks.en: including some extremely profitable pirate faction data and relic sites.
blocks.zh: 包括一些利润极高的海盗势力数据站点和遗迹站点。

blocks.en: These can be found by scanning within Class 1, 2, and 3 systems
blocks.zh: 在未知虫洞空间的 C1、C2 和 C3 星系中

blocks.en: in unknown wormhole space,
blocks.zh: 扫描就能找到它们，

blocks.en: though be careful not to accidentally
blocks.zh: 不过要小心，别一不留神

blocks.en: warp into a Sleeper infested hacking site, if you value your ship that is.
blocks.zh: 跃迁进冬眠者（Sleeper）盘踞的破解站点——如果你还在乎你的船的话。

blocks.en: When you're ready to return from wormhole space,
blocks.zh: 准备离开虫洞空间时，

blocks.en: you can simply try to head straight back out the way you came.
blocks.zh: 直接原路返回就行。

blocks.en: If you jump out within 5 minutes, however,
blocks.zh: 不过，如果你在 5 分钟内跳出，

blocks.en: your ship will become polarized to that wormhole connection
blocks.zh: 你的舰船会对该虫洞连接产生极化，

blocks.en: for 5 minutes since your first jump,
blocks.zh: 从第一次跳跃起持续 5 分钟，

blocks.en: preventing you from jumping back again for a short time.
blocks.zh: 在短时间内无法再跳回去。

blocks.en: This isn't a problem most of the time,
blocks.zh: 大多数时候这不成问题，

blocks.en: but don't let polarization catch you off guard
blocks.zh: 但当你正在躲避不友善的玩家时，

blocks.en: when you're on the run from a less than friendly player.
blocks.zh: 可别被极化效应打个措手不及。

blocks.en: Wormholes by their nature are transient pathways,
blocks.zh: 虫洞本质上是临时通道，

blocks.en: and whether a connection collapsed from the mass of multiple ships passing through
blocks.zh: 无论连接是因多艘舰船通过的质量而坍塌，

blocks.en: or simply from its natural lifetime coming to an end,
blocks.zh: 还是仅仅因为自然寿命到期，

blocks.en: you might find that your way home is gone.
blocks.zh: 你都可能发现回家的路没了。

blocks.en: This can be a scary experience but it does not mean that you are trapped,
blocks.zh: 这可能会让人害怕，但并不意味着你被困住了，

blocks.en: as long as you still have your trusty probe scanner.
blocks.zh: 只要你还有可靠的探针扫描器。

blocks.en: Every wormhole system has one or more 'static' wormholes
blocks.zh: 每个虫洞星系都有一个或多个「固定（static）」虫洞，

blocks.en: which originate within the system and lead to other areas of space.
blocks.zh: 它们从该星系出发，通往其他空间区域。

blocks.en: A class-2 wormhole system, for example,
blocks.zh: 例如，C2 虫洞星系

blocks.en: will always have at least one connection into wormhole space
blocks.zh: 总会至少有一个通往虫洞空间的连接，

blocks.en: and one back out to highsec, lowsec, or nullsec.
blocks.zh: 以及一个通往高安、低安或 00 区的出口。

blocks.en: The types of statics will vary from system to system,
blocks.zh: 固定虫洞的类型因星系而异，

blocks.en: but you can always find at least one new wormhole to follow.
blocks.zh: 但你总能找到至少一个新的虫洞继续前进。

blocks.en: Understanding and utilising wormholes can be a great way to make ISK
blocks.zh: 理解并善用虫洞是赚取 ISK 的好方法，

blocks.en: or visit far away places with just a few jumps.
blocks.zh: 也能让你只跳几次就到达遥远的地方。

blocks.en: Some Capsuleers even choose to set up a structure
blocks.zh: 有些克隆飞行员甚至选择架设建筑，

blocks.en: and live in wormhole space permanently.
blocks.zh: 在虫洞空间长期定居。

blocks.en: Whether you plan on staying a while or you're simply day tripping,
blocks.zh: 无论你是打算久居还是只想一日游，

blocks.en: knowing how to navigate wormholes safely is a valuable skill
blocks.zh: 懂得如何安全穿越虫洞都是一项宝贵的技能，

blocks.en: that will set you apart as a talented explorer in EVE Online.
blocks.zh: 能让你成为 EVE Online 中出类拔萃的探险家。
